hypothesis: A tokenless, directly programmed hierarchy of retained single-site, low-rank pair-site, and shared triple-subset weights predicts fourth-order GB1 combinations better than the strongest fully fitted conventional order<=3 categorical ridge model.

source.paper: Wu et al. 2016 eLife 5:e16965; GB1 4-site mutation landscape V39/D40/G41/V54
source.licensing: Published historical original source, derived data terms not verified for redistribution; no data bytes will be committed

admission.format: 11-tab-column original Mutcount+Mapper5 output, exactly: mut HD Input IGG10 IGG20 IGG90 I10fit I20fitRaw I90fit AOfit I20fit
admission.genotype: 4 uppercase standard amino acids; unique; Hamming distance from VDGV equals HD
admission.missing: NA or unmeasured excluded, never imputed
admission.outcome_transform: log1p(I20fitRaw), FIT-only normalization; nonnegative finite unadjusted fitness only

frozen_split.train: All source-admitted HD<=2, plus HD3 genotypes with SHA256('WSP195-GB1-HD3-FIT-v1\0'+mut) first 64 bits modulo 100<70
frozen_split.dev: All source-admitted HD4 genotypes, scored once after all selection
frozen_split.grouping: Full genotype identity, no numeric-outcome split or salt search

candidate.stages: Program HD1 site-state effects from FIT; HD2 residual cross-site pair matrices from FIT; low-rank deterministic matrix factorization using bounded 20-step power iteration; HD3 residual-motif weights from FIT to compose each HD4 from shared HD3 subsets; no gradient-based updates to programmed weights
candidate.selection: Lowest VALID-HD3 normalized RMSE, deterministic tie-break smaller rank/abs(beta)
candidate.retention: Freeze and serialize HD1/HD2 representation before and after HD3 learning, require exact restored historical predictions; otherwise INVALID
source_free_ablations: shuffled FIT HD3 residual identity seed 19521
candidate.capacity: Report scalar state bytes and fitted dimensions, not presume parity with conventional controls

controls.solver: Sparse coordinate descent, deterministic, <=250 passes, max coefficient delta <=1e-4
controls.fitting: Same FIT labels/features/source and HD4 exclusion; VALID-HD3 hyperparameter/model selection; strongest fully converged conventional
controls.negative: If no converged full degree3 model, mark INVALID rather than claiming scientific superiority

evaluation.primary: Equal-HD4-genotype normalized RMSE candidate vs strongest VALID-selected converged conventional model
evaluation.uncertainty: 1000 HD4 genotype-level bootstrap resamples seed 19531 of relative RMSE gain
evaluation.requirements: At least 5% relative lower RMSE and bootstrap 95% lower bound positive, with restored historical readout retention, no leakage for PUBLIC_DEV_SUPPORTED; otherwise PUBLIC_DEV_NO_GO
evaluation.secondary: Top 1% affinity ranking and other assays exploratory only; no after-DEV tuning
evaluation.limit: Public historical same protein, not a virgin unfamiliar-world causal intervention or native Yggdrasil learning

failure_rules.negative: Preserve one DEV negative, no retune
failure_rules.invalid: Source bytes unavailable/format/count failure, leakage, convergence/retention failure: INVALID, never call science loss
